topic: Testing local data storage limits and session behavior
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on testing how a system handles local data caching and session continuity. One participant suggested testing the impact of temporarily disconnecting a router for several hours to observe if sessions correctly map to the intended time interval, specifically regarding three-hour cache persistence.

A related topic was the mechanism for determining local data storage limits. A participant noted that their current setup lacks checks for available disk space and instead relies on writing until failure. The consensus was that implementing such a check is necessary.
decisions: Implement checking for free disk space when storing local data.
action_items: Test session continuity after temporary router disconnection (e.g., 4 hours).
